title: Warm Spicy Slovakian Pork Skillet
description: A spicy and crunchy one-pot dish featuring oregano and a sweet and tangy glaze, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe is sugar-free-friendly and can be adjusted to suit various tastes.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the pork cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the dried oregano, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Cook for 1 minute, until the spices are fragrant.
Add the sugar-free glaze and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes, until the pork is cooked through.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
